thread:
nora (Eng): Quick one - my performance review meeting is scheduled for 12/29 during company shutdown. I also have 2 days of PTO queued for 12/28-12/29. Should I cancel the PTO or can the review be rescheduled?

devon (People Ops): good question. performance cycle blackout policy says managers should avoid scheduling reviews during PTO or company-wide shutdowns. Do you prefer to move the review?

raj (Manager): i scheduled the review earlier because of calendar conflicts. happy to move it. manager preference is to do it before shutdown if possible (12/22-12/23) or after the holidays. nora, any constraints?

nora (Eng): i can shift to 12/22, that works. i was hoping to use the PTO days for personal travel but shifting is fine.

sara (Payroll): payroll note: since 12/28-12/29 are during shutdown, PTO will be paid per the standard shutdown rules. if you cancel PTO and instead take them later in Jan, submit a change before 12/20 to keep year-end reporting clean.

devon (People Ops): policy reminder for the thread: - Performance review blackout: managers should not finalize ratings or schedule review meetings on employees' approved PTO days or during company shutdown unless employee agrees. - PTO changes need manager approval and must be logged in WorkDay. Retroactive changes after payroll cutoff (12/20) may be reflected on next pay cycle.

hr_scheduler_bot: available slots for raj before shutdown: 12/19 15:00, 12/22 10:00, 12/23 09:30. After shutdown: 01/03 11:00, 01/04 14:00. Use /reschedule-review <employee_id> <slot> to confirm.

raj (Manager): booking 12/22 10:00 now. nora, consider this confirmed unless you ping.

nora (Eng): confirmed, thanks. switching PTO dates to 01/10-01/11 instead. will update in WorkDay today.

sara (Payroll): FYI once you update in WorkDay please add a comment "PTO shift approved - review rescheduled" so auditors see the reason. Also if you moved PTO into the next calendar year check with benefits about carryover impact (they may count it against next year's accrual depending on plan).

devon (People Ops): appreciated. i'll log a note on the performance cycle tracker to indicate the review was rescheduled due to employee PTO to avoid audit flags.

nora (Eng): updated WorkDay and added the comment. thanks everyone. :slightly_smiling_face:

sara (Payroll): noted. marking this closed unless there are follow-ups.

devon (People Ops): resolved  -- reaching out if similar cases pop up so we can decide if a blanket rule is needed for next cycle.
